blocks.zh: Introduction & Glossary | 導論與術語
blocks.en: Introduction & Glossary

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand why pharmaceutical manufacturing has historically been "fixed" and what triggered the shift toward mobile models — 了解製藥製造業為何歷史上以固定廠房為主，以及促成轉向行動式模式的驅動因素
blocks.en: Understand why pharmaceutical manufacturing has historically been "fixed" and what triggered the shift toward mobile models

blocks.zh: Define Mobile Manufacturing and Mobile Manufacturing Unit (MMU) using PDA's official definitions — 以 PDA 官方定義理解行動式製造與行動製造單元（MMU）的概念
blocks.en: Define Mobile Manufacturing and Mobile Manufacturing Unit (MMU) using PDA's official definitions

blocks.zh: Identify the six key terms in the PtC-15 glossary and their implications for qualification strategy — 辨識 PtC-15 術語表中六個核心詞彙及其對確效策略的含意
blocks.en: Identify the six key terms in the PtC-15 glossary and their implications for qualification strategy

blocks.zh: Recognize how single-use technology, process intensification, and geopolitical drivers converge to enable mobile manufacturing — 認識一次性技術、製程強化與地緣政治風險如何共同促成行動式製造的可行性
blocks.en: Recognize how single-use technology, process intensification, and geopolitical drivers converge to enable mobile manufacturing

blocks.zh: Apply the decision hierarchy (Product Quality → Regulatory → Business) when evaluating MMU scenarios — 在評估 MMU 情境時能應用決策優先順序（產品品質 → 法規 → 商業）
blocks.en: Apply the decision hierarchy (Product Quality → Regulatory → Business) when evaluating MMU scenarios

blocks.zh: 文件背景解讀
blocks.en: Reading the Document in Context

blocks.zh: PDA「Points to Consider」系列文件屬於指引性文件（非強制標準），提供產業界在特定技術議題上的思考框架。PtC-15 聚焦的是「行動式製造」——一個在 COVID-19 疫情後被認真重新審視的製造典範。
blocks.en: PDA "Points to Consider" documents are guidance (not mandatory standards) that give industry a framework for thinking about specific technical topics. PtC-15 focuses on "mobile manufacturing", a manufacturing paradigm that has been seriously re-examined since the COVID-19 pandemic.

blocks.zh: 為何這份文件對 CDMO 特別重要？
blocks.en: Why Does This Document Matter Especially for CDMOs?

blocks.zh: CDMO 業務模式本質上需要靈活的製造能力，無論是服務不同客戶、不同產品，還是快速響應緊急需求
blocks.en: The CDMO business model inherently requires flexible manufacturing capability, whether serving different clients and products or responding quickly to urgent demand

blocks.zh: 傳統固定廠房的建置成本高昂（通常需要數億美元），且建設時間長（3–5 年）；行動式製造提供了更短的資本周期替代路徑
blocks.en: Building a traditional fixed facility is very expensive (often hundreds of millions of US dollars) and slow (3–5 years); mobile manufacturing offers an alternative path with a shorter capital cycle

blocks.zh: 全球化供應鏈風險（疫情、地緣政治衝突、自然災害）使「製造能力可移動」的概念從「理想」變成「必要」
blocks.en: Global supply chain risks (pandemics, geopolitical conflict, natural disasters) have turned "movable manufacturing capacity" from an ideal into a necessity

blocks.zh: 作者群的代表性意義
blocks.en: Why the Authorship Matters

blocks.zh: 文件的作者來自監管機構（前 FDA/NIIMBL）、大型跨國藥廠（Pfizer、Genentech）、CDMO（Parexel）及行動製造設備商（G-CON Manufacturing）。這種組成確保了文件從技術可行性、法規合規性、商業應用性三個維度進行了完整考量。
blocks.en: The authors come from regulatory agencies (former FDA/NIIMBL), large multinational pharmaceutical companies (Pfizer, Genentech), a CDMO (Parexel), and a mobile manufacturing equipment supplier (G-CON Manufacturing). This mix ensures the document considers technical feasibility, regulatory compliance, and commercial applicability in full.

blocks.zh: 歷史脈絡解讀
blocks.en: Historical Context

blocks.zh: 類比：餐廳 vs. 餐車
blocks.en: Analogy: Restaurant vs. Food Truck

blocks.zh: 傳統製藥廠就像一間固定餐廳——廚房設備永遠安裝在同一棟建築裡，所有的基礎設施（水電、通風、儲存）都與建築結構融為一體。
blocks.en: A traditional pharmaceutical plant is like a fixed restaurant: the kitchen equipment is permanently installed in one building, and all infrastructure (power, water, ventilation, storage) is integrated into the building structure.

blocks.zh: 行動式製造就像一輛餐車（Food Truck）——廚房設備是可移動的，能夠開到有需求的地方，但仍需要符合相同的食品安全標準。
blocks.en: Mobile manufacturing is like a food truck: the kitchen equipment is movable and can be driven to wherever demand is, yet it must still meet the same food safety standards.

blocks.zh: 更專業的類比：MASH 野戰醫院（Mobile Army Surgical Hospital）——在需要的地點快速部署完整的手術能力。製藥版的 MASH 就是 MMU。
blocks.en: A closer analogy is the MASH field hospital (Mobile Army Surgical Hospital), which rapidly deploys complete surgical capability wherever it is needed. The pharmaceutical version of MASH is the MMU.

blocks.zh: Stick-built 廠房（也稱 brick-and-mortar）：指在廠區現場由各種工班（木工、電工、泥水匠等）直接施工建造的傳統廠房。這種廠房一旦建成，無法搬遷。
blocks.en: Stick-built facility (also called brick-and-mortar): a traditional facility constructed on site by various trades (carpenters, electricians, masons, etc.). Once built, it cannot be relocated.

blocks.zh: COVID-19 是關鍵的歷史轉折點——疫苗需求在數週內從零爆升至數十億劑，但固定廠房的建設週期根本無法跟上，迫使產業界認真思考「如何讓製造能力像軟體一樣可部署」。
blocks.en: COVID-19 was the key historical turning point. Vaccine demand jumped from zero to billions of doses within weeks, but fixed-facility construction timelines simply could not keep up, forcing industry to think seriously about "how to make manufacturing capacity deployable like software."

blocks.zh: 技術演進脈絡
blocks.en: Technology Evolution

blocks.zh: PDA 用了一個清晰的技術演進時間軸來說明行動式製造並非突然出現，而是各項技術成熟度的自然匯聚：
blocks.en: PDA uses a clear technology evolution timeline to show that mobile manufacturing did not appear suddenly but is the natural convergence of several maturing technologies:

blocks.zh: 行動式製造可行性方程式
blocks.en: The Mobile Manufacturing Feasibility Equation

blocks.zh:
可移動性 = f(
  潔淨室技術成熟度,        ← 1962年起
  預製化建築模組,           ← 過去20年
  工廠驗收測試(FAT)標準化,  ← 設備端的可攜帶確效
  一次性技術(SUT),          ← 1970s起，近年爆發式成長
  製程強化(PI),             ← 縮小設備尺寸
  個人化醫療趨勢            ← 小批量、多樣化
)
blocks.en:
Mobility = f(
  cleanroom technology maturity,       ← since 1962
  prefabricated building modules,      ← past 20 years
  standardized factory acceptance test (FAT),  ← portable qualification on the equipment side
  single-use technology (SUT),         ← since the 1970s, explosive growth recently
  process intensification (PI),        ← smaller equipment footprint
  personalized medicine trend          ← small batches, high variety
)

blocks.zh: FAT/SAT 在行動式製造中的核心角色
blocks.en: The Central Role of FAT/SAT in Mobile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 工廠驗收測試（FAT, Factory Acceptance Test）：設備在製造商場所完成的初始確效測試。
blocks.en: Factory Acceptance Test (FAT): the initial qualification testing of equipment performed at the manufacturer's premises.

blocks.zh: 現場驗收測試（SAT, Site Acceptance Test）：設備到達最終安裝地點後的確認測試。
blocks.en: Site Acceptance Test (SAT): confirmation testing performed after the equipment arrives at its final installation site.

blocks.zh: 傳統觀念認為確效必須在「最終廠房」進行。MMU 的核心概念之一，就是將 FAT 的結果可攜帶地移轉到新地點，避免重複完整的驗證活動。這直接挑戰了現有法規框架，也是 PtC-15 後續章節的核心問題。
blocks.en: Conventional thinking holds that qualification must take place in the "final facility." One core idea of the MMU is to transfer FAT results portably to a new location, avoiding a full repeat of validation activities. This directly challenges the existing regulatory framework and is the central question for the later sections of PtC-15.

blocks.zh: 三大驅動力深度解析
blocks.en: The Three Drivers in Depth

blocks.zh: 驅動力一：一次性技術（Single-Use Technology, SUT）
blocks.en: Driver 1: Single-Use Technology (SUT)

blocks.zh: 一次性技術的革命性在於：它將清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）從製造流程中移除。傳統不鏽鋼設備需要大量清洗、滅菌、再確效的工作；一次性設備則是用完即棄，大幅簡化跨批次、跨地點的交叉污染管控。
blocks.en: The revolutionary aspect of single-use technology is that it removes cleaning validation from the manufacturing process. Traditional stainless steel equipment requires extensive cleaning, sterilization, and re-qualification; single-use equipment is disposable after use, greatly simplifying cross-contamination control between batches and between sites.

blocks.zh: 對 MMU 而言，這意味著：每次部署不需要重新執行清潔驗證，降低了行動式製造的法規複雜度。
blocks.en: For an MMU, this means cleaning validation does not need to be repeated for each deployment, which lowers the regulatory complexity of mobile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 驅動力二：地緣政治風險
blocks.en: Driver 2: Geopolitical Risk

blocks.zh: COVID-19 之後，各國政府意識到關鍵藥品的生產不能高度集中在單一國家或地區。「在地製造（In-Country Manufacturing）」需求急速上升。
blocks.en: After COVID-19, governments realized that production of critical medicines cannot be highly concentrated in a single country or region. Demand for "In-Country Manufacturing" has risen sharply.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 業者而言，能夠提供「可在客戶國境內快速部署的 MMU」，將成為重要的競爭差異化優勢。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, being able to offer an "MMU that can be rapidly deployed within the client's own country" will become an important competitive differentiator.

blocks.zh: 驅動力三：製程強化與個人化醫療
blocks.en: Driver 3: Process Intensification and Personalized Medicine

blocks.zh: 傳統大批量生產（如年產百億劑疫苗）需要巨型廠房。但基因療法、細胞療法、個人化腫瘤疫苗的目標患者群往往只有數十至數千人——小批量、高彈性、多樣化成為新的生產需求，恰好符合 MMU 的能力特性。
blocks.en: Traditional high-volume production (such as billions of vaccine doses a year) requires massive facilities. But gene therapies, cell therapies, and personalized cancer vaccines often target patient populations of only dozens to thousands. Small batches, high flexibility, and high variety are the new production requirements, which fits the MMU's capabilities well.

blocks.zh: 範圍界定的重要性
blocks.en: Why Scope Definition Matters

blocks.zh: PtC-15 的範圍聲明中有一個關鍵詞值得反覆咀嚼：
blocks.en: One key phrase in the PtC-15 scope statement deserves repeated attention:

blocks.zh: 核心目標：「無需重新預先核准或再驗證」
blocks.en: Core objective: "without the need for new pre-approval or revalidation"

blocks.zh: 傳統法規要求：當一個已驗證的製程移至新地點，通常需要向監管機構重新申請核准，並在新地點執行完整的再驗證。
blocks.en: Traditional regulatory requirement: when a validated process is moved to a new site, it usually requires a new approval filing to the regulatory authority and full revalidation at the new site.

blocks.zh: PtC-15 探索的問題是：能否設計出一套系統，使得已在甲地驗證的製造能力，能夠在無需重新核准的情況下移至乙地繼續生產？
blocks.en: The question PtC-15 explores is: can a system be designed so that manufacturing capability validated at Site A can be moved to Site B and continue production without new approval?

blocks.zh: 這是一個非常大膽的目標，直接涉及現行 GMP 法規的根本假設——而這也是 Topic 2（法規考量）整章要處理的核心問題。
blocks.en: This is a very bold goal that touches the fundamental assumptions of current GMP regulations, and it is the core question that the entire Topic 2 (regulatory considerations) chapter addresses.

blocks.zh: 比喻：ISBU（海運貨櫃）標準化
blocks.en: Metaphor: Standardization of the ISBU (Shipping Container)

blocks.zh: 國際標準貨櫃（ISO Shipping Container Unit, ISBU）的革命性不在於「能裝很多貨」，而在於標準化——無論在哪個港口，碼頭設備都能處理相同規格的貨櫃。
blocks.en: The revolutionary aspect of the ISO shipping container unit (ISBU) is not that it "holds a lot of cargo" but its standardization: at any port, the dock equipment can handle containers of the same specification.

blocks.zh: MMU 的理想狀態類似：設計一個標準化的製造單元，使其在任何符合條件的地點都能如預期運作，而不需要針對每個地點重新「客製化」確效工作。
blocks.en: The ideal state of the MMU is similar: a standardized manufacturing unit designed to perform as expected at any qualified location, without redoing "customized" qualification work for each site.

blocks.zh: 排除範圍說明：「分散式製造（Distributed Manufacturing）」和「即地醫療製造（Point-of-Care Manufacturing）」是更廣義的概念，涉及更複雜的法規框架。PtC-15 刻意將範圍限縮在「可移動的、已完整確效的製造單元」，以保持討論的聚焦性。
blocks.en: Excluded scope: "Distributed Manufacturing" and "Point-of-Care Manufacturing" are broader concepts involving more complex regulatory frameworks. PtC-15 deliberately limits its scope to "movable, fully qualified manufacturing units" to keep the discussion focused.

blocks.zh: 決策優先順序框架
blocks.en: Decision Priority Framework

blocks.zh:
Level 1: 產品品質與病患安全
GMP 合規性在任何地點均不妥協
blocks.en:
Level 1: Product Quality and Patient Safety
GMP compliance is never compromised at any location

blocks.zh:
Level 2: 法規合規性
驗證可攜帶性、多管轄區要求
blocks.en:
Level 2: Regulatory Compliance
Portability of validation, multi-jurisdiction requirements

blocks.zh:
Level 3: 商業靈活性
速度、成本、CDMO 業務模型
blocks.en:
Level 3: Business Flexibility
Speed, cost, CDMO business model

blocks.zh: 這個優先順序框架在實務中的意義：
blocks.en: What this priority framework means in practice:

blocks.zh: 不能因為「商業需求緊迫」而跳過地點確效步驟
blocks.en: Site qualification steps cannot be skipped because "business needs are urgent"

blocks.zh: 不能因為「成本考量」而降低移動後的環境監控標準
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring standards after relocation cannot be lowered because of "cost considerations"

blocks.zh: 法規層面的不確定性，必須在技術設計階段就納入考慮（而非事後補救）
blocks.en: Regulatory uncertainty must be considered at the technical design stage (not fixed after the fact)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示
blocks.en: Implications for CDMOs

blocks.zh: CDMO 在推銷 MMU 服務時，常見的錯誤是先強調「速度快、成本低」（Level 3），而忽略客戶最關心的問題：「移動後我的產品品質會一樣嗎？」（Level 1）和「監管機構會接受嗎？」（Level 2）。
blocks.en: A common mistake when a CDMO pitches MMU services is to lead with "fast and low cost" (Level 3) and overlook what clients care about most: "Will my product quality be the same after the move?" (Level 1) and "Will regulators accept it?" (Level 2).

blocks.zh: 正確的溝通順序應該是：先建立品質保證框架，再談商業價值。
blocks.en: The right communication order is to establish the quality assurance framework first, and only then discuss business value.

blocks.zh: Glossary — 術語表 (PDA PtC-15, p.3–4)
blocks.en: Glossary (PDA PtC-15, p.3–4)

blocks.zh: Definitions have been provided to help clarify the concepts discussed in this document. Where a definition is based on another published source, the source is cited. | 以下定義用於澄清本文件中使用的概念。若定義引自其他已發表來源，則會標明出處。
blocks.en: Definitions have been provided to help clarify the concepts discussed in this document. Where a definition is based on another published source, the source is cited.

blocks.zh: Abbreviations — 縮寫表
blocks.en: Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 重要縮寫補充說明
blocks.en: Supplementary Notes on Key Abbreviations

blocks.zh: PtC-15 正式縮寫表只列了兩個縮寫（FEI 和 MMU），但文件中大量使用了製藥業標準縮寫。以下整理本節相關的關鍵縮寫：
blocks.en: The official PtC-15 abbreviation list contains only two abbreviations (FEI and MMU), but the document uses many standard pharmaceutical industry abbreviations. The key abbreviations relevant to this section are summarized below:

blocks.zh: 概念關聯圖解
blocks.en: Concept Relationship Diagram

blocks.zh: 理解 PtC-15 的關鍵在於掌握以下三個層次的概念關係：
blocks.en: The key to understanding PtC-15 is grasping the relationships among the following three levels of concepts:

blocks.zh: 三種製造方式的本質差異
blocks.en: Essential Differences Among the Three Manufacturing Approaches

blocks.zh:
Stick-Built（傳統磚造）
  → 廠房 = 建築物本身
  → 生產能力 = 固定在土地上
  → 搬遷 = 不可能

Prefabricated（預製化）
  → 廠房 = 預製模組 + 現場組裝
  → 生產能力 = 固定在特定地點
  → 搬遷 = 理論上可以，但實務困難

MMU（行動製造單元）
  → 廠房 = 自成體系的可移動單元
  → 生產能力 = 綁定在「單元」上，而非「地點」
  → 搬遷 = 設計目標，法規框架建立中
blocks.en:
Stick-Built (traditional brick-and-mortar)
  → Facility = the building itself
  → Production capability = fixed to the land
  → Relocation = impossible

Prefabricated
  → Facility = prefabricated modules + on-site assembly
  → Production capability = fixed to a specific site
  → Relocation = possible in theory, difficult in practice

MMU (Mobile Manufacturing Unit)
  → Facility = self-contained movable unit
  → Production capability = tied to the "unit," not the "site"
  → Relocation = a design goal; regulatory framework still being established

blocks.zh: 表格中「Unit-registered（concept）」一欄說明了 MMU 法規框架目前仍在發展中——現行法規主要基於「地點登記（site registration）」，如何轉向「單元登記（unit registration）」，是全球監管機構目前面臨的核心挑戰。
blocks.en: The "Unit-registered (concept)" column in the table shows that the regulatory framework for the MMU is still developing. Current regulations are based mainly on "site registration," and how to move toward "unit registration" is the core challenge now facing regulators worldwide.

blocks.zh: Self-Check Questions — 自我檢測
blocks.en: Self-Check Questions

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境思考
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenarios

blocks.zh: 情境一：客戶要求在台灣本地生產
blocks.en: Scenario 1: A Client Requires Production in Taiwan

blocks.zh: 一家歐洲藥廠委託你的 CDMO（台灣）生產其 mRNA 疫苗原液。客戶要求在台灣境內設立製造點以符合台灣政府的「本地製造優先」政策，但又不願意等待你建設新廠房的 3 年時間。
blocks.en: A European pharmaceutical company commissions your CDMO (in Taiwan) to manufacture its mRNA vaccine drug substance. The client requires a manufacturing site within Taiwan to comply with the Taiwanese government's "local manufacturing first" policy, but is unwilling to wait the 3 years it would take you to build a new facility.

blocks.zh: 問：如何利用 MMU 概念設計一套解決方案？初始確效地點應設在哪裡？誰負責 PQS？
blocks.en: Question: How would you use the MMU concept to design a solution? Where should the initial qualification site be? Who is responsible for the PQS?

blocks.zh: 情境二：CDMO 的行動式備援能力
blocks.en: Scenario 2: CDMO Mobile Backup Capability

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 目前唯一的無菌填充產線在一次設備損壞後需要停工 6 個月大修。有三個大客戶的商業批次排程受到影響，合約中有交期罰款條款。
blocks.en: Your CDMO's only sterile filling line must be shut down for a 6-month overhaul after an equipment failure. The commercial batch schedules of three major clients are affected, and the contracts include delivery penalty clauses.

blocks.zh: 問：若公司提前部署了一台備援 MMU，需要事先完成哪些確效工作，才能在緊急情況下的 30 天內啟動生產？Hint: 參考「Family Approach」和「初始確效地點」的定義。
blocks.en: Question: If the company had pre-deployed a backup MMU, what qualification work would need to be completed in advance so that production could start within 30 days in an emergency? Hint: refer to the definitions of "Family Approach" and "initial qualification site."

blocks.zh: 情境三：新興市場部署
blocks.en: Scenario 3: Deployment in an Emerging Market

blocks.zh: 你的跨國製藥集團計劃在非洲部署 MMU 生產胰島素，以解決當地的在地製造需求。目標國家沒有完整的藥品 GMP 法規框架。
blocks.en: Your multinational pharmaceutical group plans to deploy an MMU in Africa to produce insulin and meet local manufacturing needs. The target country has no complete pharmaceutical GMP regulatory framework.

blocks.zh: 問：MMU 的「地點無關確效狀態」在這個場景下面臨的最大挑戰是什麼？如何與 WHO 預認證框架結合？
blocks.en: Question: What is the biggest challenge to the MMU's "site-independent qualification status" in this scenario? How would you combine it with the WHO prequalification framework?

blocks.zh: 章節學習總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心學習成果確認
blocks.en: Confirming Core Learning Outcomes

blocks.zh: 完成本節學習後，你應該能夠回答：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you should be able to answer:

blocks.zh: 為什麼 COVID-19 是行動式製造的「催化劑」而非「起點」？（技術演進早已開始）
blocks.en: Why was COVID-19 the "catalyst" rather than the "starting point" of mobile manufacturing? (The technology evolution had already begun.)

blocks.zh: MMU 與「傳統預製模組廠房」的本質差異是什麼？（設計目標：可移動 + 確效可攜帶）
blocks.en: What is the essential difference between an MMU and a "traditional prefabricated modular facility"? (Design goal: movable + portable qualification.)

blocks.zh: 「初始確效地點」在法規框架中扮演什麼角色？（確效可攜帶性的基準起點）
blocks.en: What role does the "initial qualification site" play in the regulatory framework? (It is the baseline starting point for portable qualification.)

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PtC-15 要排除「即地醫療製造」的範圍？（降低複雜度，聚焦核心問題）
blocks.en: Why does PtC-15 exclude "point-of-care manufacturing" from its scope? (To reduce complexity and focus on the core question.)

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀建議
blocks.en: Suggested Further Reading

blocks.zh: 本節內容是整份 PtC-15 的基礎。後續各 Topic 的學習路徑：
blocks.en: This section is the foundation of the entire PtC-15. The learning path for the subsequent Topics:

blocks.zh: Topic 1（技術考量）：深入了解 MMU 的具體技術選項和確效實務
blocks.en: Topic 1 (Technical Considerations): a deeper look at specific MMU technical options and qualification practice

blocks.zh: Topic 2（法規考量）：理解目前監管框架對 MMU 的障礙和各國監管機構的因應方向
blocks.en: Topic 2 (Regulatory Considerations): understanding the barriers the current regulatory framework poses for MMUs and how regulators in different countries are responding

blocks.zh: Topic 3（實施）：實際在新地點驗證 MMU 的步驟和方法
blocks.en: Topic 3 (Implementation): the actual steps and methods for qualifying an MMU at a new site

blocks.zh: Appendix A：全球主要法規框架（FDA、EMA、ICH 等）對行動製造的現行規範要求匯整
blocks.en: Appendix A: a consolidated summary of how major global regulatory frameworks (FDA, EMA, ICH, etc.) currently address mobile manufacturing
